inspection_scope: Two selected printed edition pages; no ancient manuscript images

observations.finding: Printed main text skips reference 51; apparatus reports [51 om ADE]. Missing digital key is not itself a digital loss.
Print starts chapter 32:1 with Jacob departure; digital TEI/downstream place its opening at 31:55 and contaminate both with XXXII.
Tower-of-Gader journey printed at Greek 35:16 with alternative reference (21); it is already in the LXXL baseline. Reuben occurs at Greek 35:21 with alternative (22).
Printed epekeina is present in LXXL baseline but absent from TEI and downstream Swete transcription.
